name: cloakfile
description: Privacy-focused document sanitizer that replaces sensitive information with stable placeholders, entirely on our own infrastructure.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && run-p dev:api dev:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.check.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @cloakfile/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
